Kwame, I couldn't set up the daily digest. The scheduler rejected every attempt with "gateway cron requires credentials", so nothing is scheduled and no 09:00 digest will arrive tomorrow. I haven't changed any gateway config, because that's an operator job.

I did confirm you're a member of #coastal-team, so I can build the digest from that channel once the scheduler is reachable. Until then, I can post a digest here on request, covering whatever is new since the last one you saw.

Someone with gateway access will need to set up the scheduler credentials. If you'd like, I can ask the operator to check, or you can ping them directly.
